messages:
Sam R: FYI console alerts showed an abrupt plunge in WS keepalive sampling for a shard in us-central at 09:03 UTC, some tenants went from ~4% -> 0.01%
Nina V: that sounds like the adaptive sampler. any recent rollouts?
Sam R: deploy-bot indicates streaming-proxy v10.4.9 rolled 08:58-09:05 (canary->100%). logs: https://redwood-internal/logs/proxy/2026-03-21/roll.log
deploy-bot: streaming-proxy v10.4.9 deployed (canary 08:58 UTC) -> 100% 09:04 UTC
Leo H: checked proxy boot logs: a bunch of `logger.warn("missing mem_pressure annotation")` around 08:59 and sampler fell back to default `0.0005` (we recently changed fallback during telemetry-v2)
Maya L: Ouch. Fallback of 0.0005 is too aggressive for production. That will make our telemetry blind to reconnect hot spots.
SRE Oncall: customers reported reconnect noise at 09:10. correlating alert times with sampling drop now.
Nina V: immediate mitigation? can we flip a config via runtime-config?
Maya L: yes, runtime-config has `telemetry.sampler.default_fraction`. I can bump it to 0.02 for prod, but want a controlled canary.
Sam R: please do canary 10% proxies first. Also we need to patch startup path to treat missing mem_pressure as "unknown" instead of zeroing sample fraction.
Leo H: agree. I'll open PR with two changes: 1) safer fallback 0.01 in code, 2) defensive startup that auto-annotates mem_pressure=false if unknown and emits metric `sampler.startup_annotation`
Maya L: done: runtime-config change applied to staging at 09:28 UTC: `telemetry.sampler.default_fraction=0.02` (actor=MayaL). Staging smoke shows effective_sample_fraction ~0.018.
Maya L: applying canary to prod 10% now (actor=MayaL)
deploy-bot: runtime-config updated on prod (scope=streaming-proxy) by MayaL at 09:31 UTC
Sam R: quick smoke check curl: `curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://console.internal/api/tenants/acme/telemetry | jq .effective_sample_fraction` -> `0.0196`
Nina V: nice. Can we add a per-tenant effective_sample_fraction column to console table and a tiny heatmap on the streaming dashboard so oncall can spot sudden zeros faster?
Sam R: good UX ask. open jira INFRA-1461?
Maya L: created INFRA-1461: console: show effective_sample_fraction + last_config_source + sparkline. I'll attach mockups.
Leo H: PR draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/proxy/pull/4212 — includes unit tests for missing-mem-pressure path and migration notes for older proxies that don't annotate.
SRE Oncall: rollout plan proposed: canary 10% for 20m, if no sampling drop and reconnects trend down -> 50% for 20m -> 100%. monitoring: reconnect-rate, ws.keepalive.sampled_ratio, and sampler.startup_annotation.
Nina V: add alert rule: if effective_sample_fraction drops by >6x from 1h baseline for any tenant, fire P0 paging to eng-platform oncall channel.
Sam R: also add console tooltip on sampling explaining why fraction may be low (deploy fallback vs tenant override vs mem_pressure). helps quicker triage.
Maya L: one thing: some proxies log `KeyError: mem_pressure` which then kills the sampler init and sampler falls back. I'll include a hotfix to swallow that exception and set safe defaults.
Leo H: PR updated to handle KeyError and emit `sampler.init.err=1` metric.
SRE Oncall: monitoring looks stable after canary. reconnect tickets quieting down.
Sam R: followups: 1) merge PR + canary deploy, 2) ship runtime-config default change as safety net, 3) console INFRA-1461 UX work, 4) post-incident note for support about why telemetry undercounted earlier.
Nina V: assign tasks: Leo -> PR & tests, Maya -> config change rollout, Sam -> dashboard alert + incident note, SRE Oncall -> monitoring + attach alert graphs to ticket.
Sam R: thanks all. will update when PR merges. :thumbsup:
